description_en: Calls DescribeColdStorage to retrieve the cold storage information of an instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeColdStorage获取实例的冷存储信息
name: DescribeColdStorage

parameters.help_en: The ID of target instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html to obtain target instance ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

ColdStorageSize.description_en:
The total storage capacity of cold storage, in GB.

This parameter is returned only when OpenStatus is open
ColdStorageSize.description_zh:
冷存储的总存储容量，单位为GB。

当OpenStatus返回值为open时才会返回此参数

ColdStorageType.description_en: The cold storage type. For newly created BDS instances, the cold storage type is BdsColdStorage. This parameter is not returned for other instances by default
ColdStorageType.description_zh: 冷存储类型，新创建的BDS实例冷存储类型为BdsColdStorage，其他默认不返回此参数

ColdStorageUseAmount.description_en:
The amount of cold storage space used, in GB.

This parameter is returned only when OpenStatus is open
ColdStorageUseAmount.description_zh:
冷存储空间的使用量，单位为GB。

当OpenStatus返回值为open时才会返回此参数

ColdStorageUsePercent.description_en:
The usage of the cold storage space, in percentage (%).

This parameter is returned only when OpenStatus is open
ColdStorageUsePercent.description_zh:
冷存储空间的使用率，单位为%。

当OpenStatus返回值为open时才会返回此参数

OpenStatus.description_en:
The enabling status of cold storage. Valid values:
open: Cold storage is enabled.
close: Cold storage is not enabled
OpenStatus.description_zh:
冷存储开启状态，返回值：
open： 已开启。
close：未开启

PayType.description_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:
PREPAY: subscription.
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go
PayType.description_zh:
实例的付费类型，返回值：
PREPAY ：包年包月（预付费）。
POSTPAY：按量付费（后付费）
